neighbours.label: the count word opening a compound product or structure description (six-pack, three layered)
fire: The beer is sold in a twelve-pack at most stores.
Yogurt is launching here in a four-pack of small tubs.
Folding the sheet makes a two layered film for wrapping.
The soda comes in a six-pack or a large bottle.
The cloth is a three layered weave for tents.
Shoppers can pick a ten-pack of pens for school.
The candy ships in an eight-pack of bars.
Pressing the foam yields a five layered panel for walls.
quiet: The beer is sold in tall cans at most stores.
Yogurt is launching here in a small tub with a lid.
Folding the sheet makes a thick film for wrapping.
The soda comes in a can or a large bottle.
The cloth is a coarse weave for tents.
Shoppers bought four pens and ten pencils for school.
The candy ships in a box of chocolate bars.
Pressing the foam yields a stiff panel for walls.

short: count word in a compound (six-pack, three layered)
notes: The pole also fires at about 0.3 on position words such as ' anterior', ' lateral' and ' back' in anatomy; this label covers only the count words.
